candidates.name: Endophthalmitis
support_spans: 4 days of blurry vision and pain in her left eye
conjunctival hyperemia, faint keratic precipitates, 3+ cells with fibrin in the anterior chamber
development of hypopyon and increased fibrinous material emanating from the iris lesion
contradict_spans: The posterior segment was unremarkable, with no evidence of vitritis, retinitis, or vasculitis
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and examination findings, including blurry vision, eye pain, and intraocular inflammation, are consistent with endophthalmitis, a severe infection of the inner eye.
candidates.protected_reason: Endophthalmitis is a rare but serious condition that can be easily missed if not considered in the differential diagnosis, especially in patients with recent dental procedures.

candidates.name: Streptococcal endocarditis
support_spans: Gram stain revealed gram-positive cocci in chains
Aerobic culture revealed Streptococcus intermedius
contradict_spans: Blood and urine cultures, electrocardiogram and echocardiogram were unremarkable
candidates.why: The presence of Streptococcus intermedius in the Gram stain and culture, combined with the patient's recent dental procedure, raises the possibility of streptococcal endocarditis, which can lead to metastatic infection in the eye.
candidates.protected_reason: Streptococcal endocarditis is a rare but serious condition that can be easily missed if not considered in the differential diagnosis, especially in patients with recent dental procedures.

candidates.name: Syphilis
support_spans: whitish focal granuloma at the 4-o'clock position at the pupillary margin
contradict_spans: No posterior segment involvement was noted
candidates.why: The presence of a focal granuloma in the iris, combined with the patient's symptoms and examination findings, raises the possibility of syphilis, which can cause a range of ocular manifestations, including granulomatous inflammation.
candidates.protected_reason: Syphilis is a rare but important condition that can be easily missed if not considered in the differential diagnosis, especially in patients with atypical presentations.
